Lancet Report Warns of Extinction by 2100 from AI, Nuclear War

A new global risk assessment published in The Lancet identifies 17 catastrophic threats to human health, with nuclear war and the malicious use of Artificial Intelligence (AI)-enabled bioweapons cited as potential causes for human extinction by the year 2100. The report suggests that these threats, along with other risks, could lead to the end of humanity within the century.
